page.overview:
What is Chetwood?

It was situated near the Great East Road northeast of Bree, and at its borders lay the town of Combe. The road ran through the southern edge of the forest, while the Greenway passed through the western edge. On its eastern side lay the Midgewater Marshes.

The forest appears in as a playable location.
